mapper.select: SELECT A.PORTFOLIO_ID AS portfolioId, B.PORTFOLIO_NAME AS portfolioName, A.PARTY_ID AS partyId, C.PARTY_CUSTOMER_ID AS partyCustomerId, C.PARTY_NAME AS partyName, A.CFETS_ACCT_TYPE AS cfetsAcctType, A.CREATE_USER AS createUser, A.CREATE_DEPT AS createDept, A.CREATE_TIME AS createTime, A.UPDATE_USER AS updateUser, A.UPDATE_TIME AS updateTime FROM IBU_PORTFOLIO_ACCT_RELA A INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO B ON A.PORTFOLIO_ID = B.PORTFOLIO_ID INNER JOIN MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO C ON A.PARTY_ID = C.PARTY_ID WHERE A.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND A.PARTY_ID = #{partyId} AND A.CFETS_ACCT_TYPE = #{cfetsAcctType}
